page_title: STR 2-1 LYO | Strasbourg v Lyon 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Matz Sels pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
90+4' Bradley Barcola (Lyon) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+3' Lyon will take a corner kick.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean-Ricner Bellegarde leaves the pitch and Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) comes on.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Amin Sarr (Lyon) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
88' 2 - 1 Goal! Maxence Caqueret feeds Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 2:1.
87' Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
86' The goalkeeper dives to deny Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
86' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Rayan Cherki (Lyon) takes it short.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Amin Sarr (Lyon) will replace Alexandre Lacazette.
84' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches over the bar. He should have scored!
81' Patrick Vieira prepares a substitution. Lebo Mothiba is replaced by Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg).

75' 2 - 0 Goal! Lebo Mothiba (Strasbourg) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 2:0. He was ably assisted there by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.
74' Remy Riou comes off his line to intercept the corner from Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg).
71' Substitution. Jeffinho (Lyon) on for Johann Lepenant.
68' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Emanuel Emegha and he is replaced by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg).
68' Frederic Guilbert will be replaced by Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg).
68' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 38:62.
63' 1 - 0 Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg) scores a goal from the free kick from the edge of the box. The shot heads towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper is unable to stop it.
63' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg) will take the free kick.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sael Kumbedi (Lyon) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' A thunderous effort from long range by Rayan Cherki (Lyon) goes well wide of the left post.
53' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
52' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:3.
50' Lyon control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
48' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg) for his blatant foul.
45+4' Caution goes to Corentin Tolisso (Lyon).
45+2' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is flagged for offside.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the left post and flies out of play.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Strasbourg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is caught offside!
34' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
34' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
33' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Lyon for a penalty. Play continues.
32' Lyon force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
31' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Matz Sels makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
26' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Matz Sels.
25' Ball possession – 29:71.
21' Laurent Blanc is forced to make a change. Clinton Mata (Lyon) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Sael Kumbedi.
19' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Strasbourg) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
17' Dangerous play by Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Lyon take a short corner kick.
12' Bradley Barcola (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
9' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
9' The free kick will be taken by Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon).
8' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) has tested the patience of referee Jerome Brisard and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
7' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) picks up an injury.

5' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
